title: Who Stole My Sausages?
author: estif, interstitial, CliffRaven, mackhep07
description:
Your best friend is furious. Someone has eaten her entire pack of gourmet sausages.

Time to do some porking around. Interview your housemates, challenge their lies, find the links, and catch the resident sausage thief. A detective game with a twisting story, sizzling artwork, and the wurst puns on Itch.io. Made with pride in Kjipuktuk (Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada) for Dialogue Jam 2024.

Game contains swearing, optional substances, and mischief. Go to Settings to turn profanity on/off.

A game by Productive Pigeons:
Writing | Steve Howe
Art | Mackenzie Hepditch
Audio | Ally Arbou
Programming | Jeremy Rutledge
Programming | Noah MacAulay

Thank you for playing!
